facts.fact: The Norwegian Refugee Council reports that Somalia has no comprehensive national civil registration system and no functioning system to record vital events beyond some birth, death and marriage records produced by the Mogadishu municipality, and that civil registration is not available in IDP camps; the statement rests partly on a 2016 World Bank diagnostic and carries no date of its own, so the report's publication date is used, and it says nothing of any digital record.

The federal government adopted the National Civil Registration and Vital Statistics Policy in early 2021 to establish a public registration system for birth, death, marriage, divorce and kafalah, with a national central database to hold all vital event records and a technical working group to oversee the system's design and roll-out.
facts.system: CRVS system under the 2021 CRVS Policy (planned)

facts.fact: Under the 2021 CRVS Policy the Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation leads civil registration and hosts the CRVS Technical Working Group, with the Ministry of Health assigned notification of births and deaths through health institutions and community health staff.
